title: Olavina Aasare
desc: Jayant, a criminal, is hired by a crime boss to marry a wealthy estate owner's daughter, Rajini, and take over her property. However, in a twist of fate, things go awry.

title: Jai Simha
desc: Narasimha, a fiery but kind-hearted mechanic, becomes the guardian of an innocent family. Subsequently, he ends up taking on the ruthless kingpin Kariappan and his violent gang to protect them.

title: Rambo 2
desc: Mayuri gets kidnapped when she is on a road trip with her friends, Krishna and DJ. However, the kidnapper releases her with a message for Krishna, whom he wants to kill.

title: Pailwaan
desc: A coach on the hunt for a new fighter finds Krishna, an orphan mentored by Sarkar. Krishna evolves into Kichcha, making a name for himself in the boxing ring.

title: Rider
desc: As love blossoms between orphans Chinnu and Kitty, fate separates them as children. However, they grow up yearning to find each other.
